_: The desktop packages' outward identity, defined here once (ADR 0133 decision 12). appId: the Flatpak's application id, also the Linux app's GApplication id, D-Bus name and resource path. msixPublisher: the MSIX's Publisher, which must equal the signing certificate's subject. Both decided by the owner (2026-11-13): the owner holds veyq.app, and the released MSIX is signed by the project's own self-signed certificate of this subject. Permanent once people install a package: a changed value is a second app beside the first.
